ourStoryText: Founded to close the gap between ambition and execution, Bonn Factory was built on a simple belief: Saudi brands deserve manufacturing partners who are as dedicated to quality and speed as they are to vision. From our first production line to today’s integrated facility, we’ve kept our promise—combining advanced processes, disciplined QA/Regulatory practices, and a partnership-first mindset. We work side-by-side with founders, pharmacies, and retailers—translating briefs into stable formulas, compliant packs, and scalable production. Our team blends engineering precision with market insight, turning concepts into shelf-ready products that consumers trust and remember.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our contract manufacturing services, quality standards, and processes.

items.a: Bonn Medical Industries (BMI) is a Saudi factory specializing in contract manufacturing (OEM/Private Label) for cosmetics, skincare, haircare, and medical products. We are certified under Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and ISO standards.

items.q: Do you help with SFDA product registration?
items.a: Yes, we have a specialized regulatory team that prepares the full technical files and registers your products and brands with the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) for a compliant and legal market launch.

items.q: What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: Minimum order quantities vary depending on the product category, formulation, and type of packaging chosen. Please complete our registration form to receive a customized quote suited to your brand's requirements.

items.q: Can you develop custom formulations for my brand?
items.a: Absolutely. Our expert R&D department can formulate custom, stable, and highly effective products tailored to your specific performance targets, preferred ingredients, and market positioning.

items.q: What certifications does your factory hold?
items.a: We operate a state-of-the-art facility carrying certifications in ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality), ISO 22000 (Food Safety/Hygiene), HACCP compliance, and cGMP compliance under SFDA supervision.

items.q: Can I choose my own packaging designs?
items.a: Yes. We offer packaging design and sourcing support. We help you choose or design bottles, jars, tubes, and boxes that are compliant with local labeling regulations and match your aesthetic goals.
